title: Stale JWT reused when navigating back to Internal User embed
description: The first embed uses initialEmbedData passed from the server-rendered dashboard page. When the user navigates to the second embed and back, the SigmaEmbed component remounts and reuses the same server-rendered initialEmbedUrl, so the JWT never refreshes after the initial page load. Eventually that initial JWT expires, breaking the embed. Fix: only use initialEmbedData on the very first dashboard render; once the user navigates away, subsequent visits should fetch a fresh JWT client-side.

title: Add a new embedded workbook page
description: Add a second navigation item to the dashboard for a new embedded Sigma workbook. Needs: nav label, env var (e.g. NEWPAGE_SIGMA_BASE_URL in .env.local + Vercel), nav item entry in components/DashboardShell.js with mode set to match the env var prefix, and an appropriate icon.

title: Rename 'Workbook Embed' nav item to 'Workbook - Internal User example'
description: Update the existing nav item label in components/DashboardShell.js so it reflects its purpose as an internal-user-style embed example. Both the NAV_ITEMS top-level label and the inner embeds[].label should be updated for consistency in breadcrumbs and the JWT inspector.
